top_signals.title: 'It's Raining Gold': AI Mints Unexpected Billionaires
top_signals.summary:
The AI boom is creating a new class of billionaires in some unlikely places. Since the rise of ChatGPT in 2022, companies manufacturing overlooked industrial products and obscure hardware have seen their fortunes soar as demand for AI infrastructure takes off. Bloomberg Billionaires reporter Pui Gwen Yeung breaks down how these companies have struck gold.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Saudis Pivot to Send More Oil Through Hormuz After Pipeline Shut
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia is ramping up prompt spot sales of crude from outside the Strait of Hormuz following the shutdown of the kingdom’s East-West pipeline, which halted cross-country flows to its Red Sea coast.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: China Could Curb Fuel Exports as Diesel and Gasoline Stocks Sink
top_signals.summary: China’s diesel fuel and gasoline inventories are declining, which may eventually lead to the imposition of export curbs, Bloomberg has reported, citing recent fuel inventory data. Gasoline inventories at state-owned energy majors were down by 2.9% last week to their lowest level since 2022, according to Chinese commodity market research firm JLC International. Diesel inventories are sitting at the lowest in 15 months, booking a 2.4% dip last week, the publication noted. “With the domestic market tightening, we see an increasing risk…
